sentences.text: The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR no. 48/2021, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Hari Nagar and all other consequential proceeding emanating therefrom including the chargesheet pending before the Court of Ms. Udita Jain Garg, learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 have arrived at a settlement vide Settlement/Agreement dated 04.08.2022.
